crew.overview: One man's campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after he is revealed to be a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization known as Beekeepers.
crew.title: The Beekeeper

details.biography:
Chris Long is an English television producer and director.

He was the lead director and executive producer on The Americans and Suspicion. This was his second series for Apple, having directed and executive produced the first episode of Amazing Stories. In 2019, he also directed the pilot episode of The Right Stuff.
